headword: {年功序列|ねんこうじょれつ}

definitions.explanation: A system in which employees are promoted and receive pay raises based primarily on their length of service and age, rather than on individual performance. A hallmark of traditional Japanese corporate culture.

examples.japanese: {年功序列|ねんこうじょれつ}の{給与|きゅうよ}{体系|たいけい}を{見直|みなお}す。
{年功序列|ねんこうじょれつ}から{成果|せいか}{主義|しゅぎ}へ{移行|いこう}する{企業|きぎょう}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: More and more companies are shifting from a seniority-based system to a merit-based one.

examples.japanese: {年功序列|ねんこうじょれつ}は{安定|あんてい}をもたらす{一方|いっぽう}で、{若手|わかて}のモチベーションを{下|さ}げるという{批判|ひはん}もある。
examples.english: While the seniority system brings stability, there is also criticism that it lowers the motivation of younger employees.

notes:
CULTURE:
One of the three pillars of traditional Japanese employment, along with {終身雇用|しゅうしんこよう} (lifetime employment) and {企業別組合|きぎょうべつくみあい} (enterprise-based labor unions). Since the 1990s, many companies have gradually moved toward performance-based ({成果|せいか}{主義|しゅぎ}) evaluation systems, though seniority-based elements remain widespread.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年功序列|ねんこうじょれつ}{制|せい}: seniority system
- {年功序列|ねんこうじょれつ}{型|がた}: seniority-based model
- {年功序列|ねんこうじょれつ}を{廃止|はいし}する: to abolish the seniority system
